query:
UPDATE tasks
               SET status = $2,
                   done_at = CASE
                     WHEN $2 = 'done' AND done_at IS NULL THEN datetime('now', 'subsec')
                     WHEN $2 != 'done' THEN NULL
                     ELSE done_at
                   END,
                   updated_at = datetime('now', 'subsec')
               WHERE id = $1
